items.headline: India and Japan Sign Maritime Security Pact to Expand Strategic Defense Cooperation
items.summary: On August 20, 2026, Japanese Defense Minister Shinjiro Koizumi and Indian Defense Minister Rajnath Singh signed a landmark memorandum in New Delhi to deepen bilateral maritime security cooperation. The agreement enhances joint naval coordination, intelligence sharing, and potential collaboration in naval shipbuilding to help maintain stability across the Indo-Pacific region.

items.headline: FIFA President Gianni Infantino Faces Potential No-Confidence Vote
items.summary: Major soccer governing bodies including UEFA, AFC, and CONCACAF are reportedly considering a vote of no confidence against FIFA President Gianni Infantino [1.4.4]. The potential move follows widespread opposition from regional federations over his proposal to sell private investment stakes in major FIFA tournaments.

items.headline: Christopher Nolan's 'The Odyssey' Becomes Highest-Grossing R-Rated Movie of All Time
items.summary: Director Christopher Nolan's epic feature "The Odyssey" has reached $1.35 billion at the global box office [2.1.1]. This milestone officially makes it the highest-grossing R-rated film in cinema history, surpassing the record previously held by "Deadpool & Wolverine".
